category.title: Travel & Relocation
category.description: Practical browser-local planners for trips and moves using only information you enter.

tools.title: Relocation Milestone Timeline Builder
tools.description: Turn a move date and manually entered tasks into a dated sequence with suggested lead-time checkpoints.
tools.limitations: Dates are planning prompts only; it does not know local procedures, processing times, or appointment availability.

fields.label: Tasks as task | days before move

testValues.tasks:
Book movers | 30
Forward mail | 14
Pack essentials | 2

tools.title: Neighborhood Scorecard Calculator
tools.description: Compare candidate neighborhoods by weighted, manually entered ratings to expose trade-offs rather than relying on a single impression.
tools.limitations: Scores and weights are subjective inputs; no maps, listings, safety data, or live services are checked.

tools.title: Accommodation Comparison Matrix
tools.description: Rank manually entered lodging options across price, location, rules, and personal priorities with transparent weighted scores.
tools.limitations: All facts, prices, and ratings are user-entered; this is not a booking or availability search.

tools.title: Manual Route Stop Sequencer
tools.description: Create a repeatable stop order from a small manually entered distance matrix using a nearest-next heuristic and show total route distance.
tools.limitations: This is a heuristic, not a guaranteed shortest route; distances must be entered consistently and travel conditions are not considered.

fields.label: Stops in order for matrix rows

tools.title: Trip Day Plan Time Budgeter
tools.description: Check whether planned activities, transfers, meals, and a manual safety margin fit inside each travel day.
tools.limitations: Durations and margins are estimates you provide; the tool does not account for live delays, opening hours, or local conditions.

testValues.activities:
Day 1 | Museum | 120
Day 1 | Dinner | 90
Day 2 | Hike | 240

tools.title: Travel Document Expiry-Buffer Checker
tools.description: Compare document expiry dates with a planned return date and a user-specified safety buffer.
tools.limitations: It does not know destination entry rules or airline policies; confirm required validity with official sources.

tools.title: Relocation Address-Change Tracker
tools.description: Organize institutions and accounts into a local checklist with due dates, status, and follow-up notes.
tools.limitations: The list is only a personal tracker; it does not contact organizations or verify address-change rules.

fields.label: Records as organization | due date | status

testValues.records:
Bank | 2026-08-01 | pending
Employer | 2026-07-25 | done
Library | 2026-08-05 | pending

tools.title: Utility Service Start-Sequence Planner
tools.description: Sequence internet, power, water, and other move-in services by lead time and dependency so setup gaps are visible.
tools.limitations: Lead times and dependencies are entirely manual estimates; providers, costs, and appointment slots are not queried.

fields.label: Services as name | lead days | depends on

testValues.services:
Internet | 14 | access
Power | 3 | meter reading
Water | 2 | none

tools.title: Relocation Cost Category Splitter
tools.description: Summarize manually entered moving costs by category and calculate each category's share of the entered total.
tools.limitations: This is arithmetic on your entries, not a quote, forecast, tax calculation, or financial recommendation.

testValues.costs:
Transport | Van | 450
Supplies | Boxes | 80
Deposit | Cleaner | 120

tools.title: Travel Laundry Rotation Planner
tools.description: Estimate when a trip needs laundry by combining item counts, wear intervals, trip length, and a manually chosen wash capacity.
tools.limitations: Wear assumptions are simplified and personal; it does not assess climate, dress codes, or access to laundry facilities.

fields.label: Items as name | quantity | wears per wash

tools.title: Manual Commute Comparison Planner
tools.description: Compare commute options using entered time, transfers, cost, and reliability ratings with an adjustable priority weight.
tools.limitations: No routes, traffic, fares, or service reliability are looked up; results reflect only your estimates.

fields.label: Options as name | minutes | transfers | cost | reliability(1-5)

tools.title: Pet Relocation Task Planner
tools.description: Build a pet-move checklist from manually entered tasks, lead times, and animal-specific notes without asserting legal requirements.
tools.limitations: This is organizational only, not veterinary, airline, quarantine, or import advice; verify requirements with qualified authorities.

fields.label: Tasks as task | days before move

testValues.tasks:
Carrier acclimation | 21
Records review | 30
Travel-day food plan | 2

tools.title: Packing Volume & Capacity Estimator
tools.description: Estimate total packing volume from item dimensions and compare it with entered suitcase or vehicle capacity.
tools.limitations: Real packing efficiency, soft goods, weight limits, and irregular shapes are not modeled; use a margin before relying on the estimate.

fields.label: Items as name | quantity | length cm | width cm | height cm

tools.title: Relocation Room Fit Checker
tools.description: Check whether entered furniture footprints fit within a target room while preserving a manually specified clearance margin.
tools.limitations: This is a simple area and footprint screen, not a floor-plan, doorway, structural, or accessibility assessment.

fields.label: Furniture as name | length cm | width cm

tools.title: Relocation Storage Duration Planner
tools.description: Calculate storage days and occupied volume from entered start/end dates and item dimensions, with a packing allowance.
tools.limitations: It does not compare storage providers, rates, insurance, or access terms; dates and dimensions are your estimates.

fields.label: Stored items as name | quantity | length cm | width cm | height cm

tools.title: Travel Activity Intensity Balancer
tools.description: Review a day-by-day activity list with manually assigned effort ratings and flag consecutive high-intensity stretches.
tools.limitations: Effort ratings are subjective and not health guidance; the tool cannot assess personal fitness or medical needs.

tools.limitations: The ranking is a simple aid and does not know your household, building access, safety, or care needs.

tools.title: Travel Stop Duration Budgeter
tools.description: Allocate a total travel time across manually entered stops according to importance weights and minimum visit times.
tools.limitations: Allocations are mathematical suggestions only; opening hours, queues, transit, and personal pace are excluded.

fields.label: Stops as name | weight | minimum minutes

tools.description: Turn open questions about a destination into a prioritized evidence log with owners, due dates, and decision status.
tools.limitations: It stores and sorts your notes only; it does not research places or verify answers.

tools.title: Relocation Vehicle Load Weight Planner
tools.description: Sum manually estimated item weights and compare them with an entered payload limit by loading priority.
tools.limitations: Weights and vehicle limits are estimates; this does not replace the vehicle maker's payload, axle, tie-down, or safety instructions.

fields.label: Items as name | quantity | weight kg | priority 1-5

tools.description: Create a compact handoff list for each trip connection from manually entered tickets, references, contacts, and backup locations.
tools.limitations: This is an organization aid, not proof of admission or a check of current travel requirements.

tools.title: Relocation Decision Matrix
tools.description: Score relocation options against weighted criteria and show normalized totals plus each option's strongest and weakest criterion.
tools.limitations: It is a transparent decision aid, not a prediction; all ratings, weights, and options are supplied by you.

fields.label: Options as name | ratings in criterion order

tools.limitations: Times are rough estimates and do not account for condition, equipment, access, or local handover standards.
